rows.section_title: 211.84 Testing and approval or rejection of components, drug product containers, and closures.
rows.context: 211.84 Testing and approval or rejection of components, drug product containers, and closures.
rows.text: Each lot of components, drug product containers, and closures shall be withheld from use until the lot has been sampled, tested, or examined, as appropriate, and released for use by the quality control unit.

passages.text:
1. Purpose

To describe how raw materials, containers and closures are received, held in quarantine, sampled, tested and released or rejected.

4. Sampling

4.1 QC samples a statistically chosen number of containers of each lot (the square root of the number of containers plus one). 4.2 Containers are opened only in the sampling booth and resealed, and each sampled container is marked. 4.3 The sample containers are labelled with the material name, receipt number, the container it came from, the date and the name of the sampler.

5. Testing and release

5.1 Every lot is tested for identity. For the other specification tests, the supplier's certificate of analysis may be accepted once QC has qualified the supplier and confirms the certificate's results at least once a year. 5.2 Containers and closures are tested against their drawings. 5.3 QC changes the status label to RELEASED or REJECTED. Rejected lots are moved to the locked reject cage.

rows.text: Any lot of components, drug product containers, or closures that meets the appropriate written specifications of identity, strength, quality, and purity and related tests under paragraph (d) of this section may be approved and released for use.

passages.text:
1. Purpose

To describe how raw materials, containers and closures are received, held in quarantine, sampled, tested and released or rejected.

4. Sampling

4.1 QC samples a statistically chosen number of containers of each lot (the square root of the number of containers plus one). 4.2 Containers are opened only in the sampling booth and resealed, and each sampled container is marked. 4.3 The sample containers are labelled with the material name, receipt number, the container it came from, the date and the name of the sampler.

5. Testing and release

5.1 Every lot is tested for identity. For the other specification tests, the supplier's certificate of analysis may be accepted once QC has qualified the supplier and confirms the certificate's results at least once a year. 5.2 Containers and closures are tested against their drawings. 5.3 QC changes the status label to RELEASED or REJECTED. Rejected lots are moved to the locked reject cage.

rules.reason: The closest passage holds 40% of the terms; missing: components, drug, product, meets, strength.

model.quote: 5.3 QC changes the status label to RELEASED or REJECTED. Rejected lots are moved to the locked reject cage.
model.reason: The SOP provides for release of lots that pass testing and labels them RELEASED, but it does not state that a lot must meet the written specifications of identity, strength, quality and purity before release, and the other specification tests may rely on a supplier certificate of analysis rather than the lot's own testing.

rows.context: 211.84 Testing and approval or rejection of components, drug product containers, and closures.
rows.text: Any lot of such material that does not meet such specifications shall be rejected.
